title: Real-SWAP shared-phreatic response characterization from immutable origins
activation_rule: Do not execute until every predicate in GC_HLINK04_LOW01_READINESS_MATRIX.json is true.
In particular LOW01-A2, CONST, CARRIER01, OUTPUT01, B and D must be QUALIFIED, C1 must be characterization-complete and C2 must preserve the declared lower-half-cell exclusion.
Execution remains research-only and does not admit production bottom_mode=1.
purpose: Measure the real SWAP complete-profile response to a prescribed shared phreatic coordinate before introducing any MODFLOW storage mapping.
Keep physical storage change, diagnosed qbot and local response derivatives as separate observables.
Provide the real-SWAP evidence needed to decide later whether a secant, tangent or other discrete response is appropriate for an h-link.

immutable_origin.water_content: provider-owned B110 values frozen exactly as LOW01-B

experiments.safety_rule: All controls remain far from internal-node snap boundaries and outside the C2 unadmitted lower-half-cell gap.

immutable_origin.water_content: same immutable hydrostatic origin as LOW01-A2

experiments.safety_rule: All controls remain below the declared -300 cm bottom face.

required_outputs_per_trial: active Richards node count where applicable
candidate provenance sufficient to prove immutable-origin execution
derived_characterization: central finite-difference d(storage_change)/dH_phreatic at delta=0.01 cm and delta=0.1 cm
central finite-difference dqbot/dH_phreatic at delta=0.01 cm and delta=0.1 cm
secant storage response storage_change/(H-H_ref) for every nonzero control offset
repeatability of the H_ref trial from the same immutable origin
branch-local comparison only; no continuity requirement across branch boundaries
gates: Every trial is reconstructed from its branch-specific immutable accepted origin; no candidate becomes the origin of another trial.
All trials stay inside the preregistered admitted LOW01 envelope and use the branch predicted above.
Every trial is valid, finite and converges without alternative solver or dt retuning.
Independent complete-profile mass residual closes within the already-qualified LOW01 branch tolerance.
Repeating the central H_ref trial is bitwise deterministic in physical candidate outputs and qbot.
Both finite-difference scales produce finite storage and qbot response estimates; no equality between those derivatives is required.
The result reports storage response and qbot response separately and does not relabel either one as an exchange coefficient.
interpretation_rules: Complete-profile storage change is a physical volume response of the SWAP column over the trial window.
qbot is the diagnosed physical bottom/interface flux under the prescribed H_phreatic trial.
A derivative of storage with respect to H_phreatic is not automatically the same object as dqbot/dH_phreatic.
Neither derivative is automatically the production F-GC q_u/u response.
A later MODFLOW h-link experiment must derive its time-discrete residual from these measured physical quantities before mapping to STO/API arrays.
forbidden: no execution before LOW01 readiness is complete
no interpolation across the C2 geometry gap
no node-boundary or snap-point controls in HLINK04
no continuity claim between inside-profile and below-profile branches
no secant-versus-tangent production choice from HLINK04 alone
no retuning of controls or dt after observation
next_if_characterized: Construct HLINK05 as a separately preregistered one-cell MODFLOW coupling experiment using one explicit time-discrete physical residual.
Keep HLINK02 numerical-certification findings as independent solver-representation evidence.
Only compare real-SWAP storage response with production q_u/u after both are evaluated from the same immutable origin and control coordinate.
